1.

Thy night of sorrow is ended, An eternal sun has risen, Our Lord Jesus Christ, for Thou Thy glory hast attained.

2.

That day shines forth, Whose sun never sets, For the Son of Man is now exalted In the Father’s glory.

3.

Thou wast the grain of wheat That fell into the earth; A harvest Thou didst bring forth to Thy God, Alone Thou art no more.

4.

And now around Thyself Thou gatherest Thy company, To lead it in the Spirit’s power Into the Father’s presence.

5.

In Thy counsel, O God, Thou hast laid this plan, Thy work, our beloved Lord Jesus, The whole hath accomplished.
